subregion.name: Deep Southern Spires

subregion.name: Eastern Sanctum
subregion.summary: An isolated southeastern wing of vaulted halls, passages, and quiet sanctuaries.

subregion.name: Forgotten Nave
subregion.summary: A sprawl of decaying ceremonial halls and collapsed corridors in the southwest midsection.

subregion.name: Grand Promenade
subregion.summary: A bustling central junction lined with open halls, meeting spaces, and crossroads.

subregion.name: Northeast Galleries
subregion.summary: A cluster of interconnected high halls and passageways overlooking the eastern grounds.

subregion.name: Northern Antechambers
subregion.summary: A grand entryway complex of wide halls and reception chambers at the northern boundary.

subregion.name: Southern Colonnade
subregion.summary: Broad pillared corridors and ceremonial chambers bridging the central southern expanse.

subregion.name: Sunken Crypts
subregion.summary: Deep, shadowy burial chambers and cold stone vaults anchoring the far southwest corner.

subregion.name: Undercroft Vaults
subregion.summary: An extensive network of cavernous pillared halls and subterranean stores at the core.

subregion.name: Western Cloisters
subregion.summary: Quiet stone passages and orderly halls tucked along the western interior flank.
